propositions: Rebar reconciler hardcodes Jira project workflow mappings in three separate locations, preventing support for projects whose workflow lacks analogous concepts without core edits

A provider-neutral, config-driven mapping seam must be introduced to read status, type, link-relation, and priority mappings from rebar.toml with layered precedence (built-in default → config default block → per-project overlay)

Non-allowed state transitions must be handled by replaying the recorded STATUS event log sequence from rebar core and falling back to drift (with warning) when no recorded trail exists or replay fails
Non-representable ticket types must support collapse (round-trip-safe via rebar-type label), skip (whole-ticket exclusion), or fail-closed validation at config load time
Non-representable parent relationships must drift with an echo-safe breadcrumb comment naming the nearest represented ancestor's Jira key
Required-field create failures must be prevented by a per-project create_defaults config block injected during issue creation
